passage.title: Kip the Koala
passage.text:
Kip lived in a eucalyptus tree beside a river, in one of the last patches of bushland not cleared for farmland nearby. Eucalyptus leaves are mildly toxic to most animals, which meant Kip had very little competition for food.

A storm tore through the bushland overnight, snapping branches and flooding the ground below. Kip gripped his tree with sharp, curved claws built exactly for holding on.

When the storm passed, Kip's friend Wren flew down to check on him. She explained that storms like this were becoming more frequent as more bushland disappeared, leaving fewer safe trees nearby.

Kip realised how much he depended on that one patch of forest — for food, shelter and safety. “If people plant more of these trees,” Wren said, “there will be more koalas like you.”

glossary.meaning: Natural land with native trees and plants.

mission.title: Kip's Lost Map
mission.goal: Find Kip's 7 map clues and dig up the Compass piece!

intro.line: Oh, Sparky, thank goodness you're here! The big storm blew my treasure map right out of my tree.
It showed the way to a piece of the Heartwood Compass. Without it, the animals can't find their way home.
Don't worry, Kip! We'll find every clue and dig up that treasure together.
Start by reading my diary on the Story Stone. It tells what happened in the storm.

beats.setup: Tweet tweet! I saw where the first clue landed. Listen carefully to my message!
beats.success: That's right! Follow me, the path is this way!
beats.fail: Oh no, that's not what I said. Fly back and listen again!

beats.setup: This signpost has my diary page pinned to it. Answer a question about my story and it will point the way.
beats.success: The sign is spinning! It points to the next clue.
beats.fail: Hmm, the sign is stuck. Let's read the story again and try once more.
beats.clue: The old signpost points past the gum trees

beats.setup: Rumble... I am Boulder, keeper of the jungle door. Answer my word riddle, and I shall let you pass.
beats.success: A wise answer. The door is open.
beats.fail: Rumble rumble... not quite. Come back and try another riddle.
beats.clue: Behind Boulder's door is the river

beats.setup: G'day! The storm smashed my bridge. Help me count the planks and we'll build it back together!
beats.success: Beauty! Look at those planks drop in. Across you go!
beats.fail: Whoops, wrong count! The planks fell in the river. Let's try again.
beats.clue: Cross Wally's bridge over the river

beats.setup: This vine ladder wilted in the storm. Use your science brain to bring it back to life!
beats.success: Look, it's growing! Up we go!
beats.fail: The vine is still droopy. Let's think again.
beats.clue: Climb the vine to the high ledge

beats.setup: A treasure chest with a pattern lock! Work out what comes next to open it.
beats.success: Click! The chest is open, and there's a clue inside!
beats.fail: The lock won't budge. Let's go back and look at the pattern again.
beats.clue: The chest's clue: dig by the tallest tree

beats.setup: This is the treasure vault! It needs a password. Listen closely and spell it out.
beats.success: The vault is open! The treasure spot is just ahead!
beats.fail: Wrong password. The vault stays shut. Back to the checkpoint to try again!

finale.line: You found every clue! X marks the spot. Dig, Sparky, dig!
A piece of the Heartwood Compass! It's glowing!
Thank you, Sparky! Take it back to Wildlands, and the forest will start to come back to life.
